title: Z.ai unveils GLM-5.4, debuting loop transformer architecture, general coding paradigm
html: Chinese artificial intelligence firm Z.ai officially released its next-generation flagship model, GLM-5.4, marking the company's first flagship model built on a loop transformer architecture and the starting point of its push toward a general coding paradigm.
